notes.title: v0.5 MEGA UPDATE
notes.notes:
If the last couple updates have seemed a little sparse, it's because I've been working to implement a LOT of new features into [i]Orbit: Satellite Defense[/i], and this week they're all ready to go live AT ONCE! Now that I've delivered on [i]all [/i]the Early Access goals for [i]Orbit: Satellite Defense[/i], I can announce that the [b]1.0[/b] version of the game will launch [b]March 26th, 2018[/b]! It'll mostly be bug-fixes and polish from this point on unless I get any suggestions for what you'd like to see in the game, so get in touch! Now is your best chance to grab [i]Orbit: Satellite Defense[/i] at it's discounted Early Access price before the 1.0 launch of the game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31854967/d967475677168ab6d51e69c06d5063506dde65b3.png[/img]
[h1]v0.5 Release Notes:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Campaign World 5[/b][list][*]5 New Levels to Play![/*][/list][/*][*][b]Added Challenge Modes[/b]:[list][*][i]Nightmare[/i]: Defend HADES from an influx of Shades[/*][*][i]Bombs Away[/i]: Deploy Magnetic Mines to blast foes away[/*][*][i]Unstable[/i]: The planet JADE is experiencing damaging tremors[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Added Steam Leaderboards[/b]: Accessed from Play Button[list][*]Campaign Score Total[/*][*]Endless Mode Score Total[/*][*]Challenge Mode Score Total[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Added Asteroids[/b]:[list][*]Smashes through Satellites and keeps going[/*][*]Destroys the Planet in one hit[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Overshield[/b]: Now grows in size and bounces back all enemies it hits[/*][*]Created Endless Mode Sub-Menu to tidy up primary Play Menu[/*][*]Satellite Decommissioning:[list][*]Increased Detonation distance to 80 (from 64) for all Satellites[/*][*]Increased Detonation distance to 96 (from 64) for the Magnetic Mine[/*][*]Satellites in the process of being Decommissioned no longer count:[list][*]Toward number of available slots (which would prevent you from building a new Satellite even though you had a free slot)[/*][*]Toward "having a Satellite" in a "limited" mode[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed:[list][*]Highscore Star padding[/*][*]Loading a file with a Decommissioned Satellite[/*][*]Upon losing a level, players will return to the appropriate menu if they wish to try again[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31854967/32891311053d268fa8accae0f2927bf094ac2401.png[/img]
Look forward to another update next week!

notes.title: Early v0.4.2 Update!
notes.notes:
Done slightly ahead of schedule; the latest Build of OSD is live NOW along with a brand-new game mode! It's accessible right from the main menu, and I hope you give [b]Warp Mode[/b] (called "Range Limit" in-game) a try! This new mode was inspired by feedback from players on Steam. Don't forget, you can submit feedback about the game using the Google Form linked at the end of the post.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31854967/ffbf601587b1c3d51e0dd21f1bc29b59b857a8f6.png[/img]

[h1]v0.4.2 Release Notes:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Added "Warp Mode"[/b] (Challenge Mode 2):[list][*]Satellites can warp instantly between Slots, but have reduced range[/*][*]Enemies move at 50% speed[/*][/list][/*][*][b]New Score Screen[/b]: Fancier conclusion to beating a level[list][*]Added button to replay current level[/*][*]Added button to move on to next level[/*][*]Laid groundwork for Level Objectives[/*][/list][/*][*]Menu buttons no longer glow when they cannot be selected (if another menu must be closed first)[/*][*]Added tool-tips to non-Menu Buttons[/*][*]Added [b]Hotkeys[/b] to Manual:[list][*]"T" - Toggle Tooltip[/*][*]"H" - Toggle Satellite Health indicators[/*][*]"F4" - Toggle Fullscreen[/*][/list][/*][*][u]Bug Fix[/u]: Satellites seem to have infinite range when a file is loaded[/*][*][u]Bug Fix[/u]: Overshield percentage not displayed over the Planet's Health when the game begins[/*][/list]

Look forward to another update next week!

notes.title: Early v0.4.1 Update!
notes.notes:
Due to a delay in publishing the game live to Steamworks this morning, I had a little extra time to add in a few more features:

[h1]v0.4.1 Release Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Solar Satellite can now Super-Charge the Magnetic Mine dealing 6 points of damage on detonation (up from 2)
[*]Pressing "Back" when viewing a Main Menu Sub-menu will take you to the previous Menu instead of closing it
[*]Campaign Planet previews & description now fade in and text is printed out
[*]In Campaign: Changed Pause menu button to read "Restart Level" instead of "New Game"
[*]Added Button in Campaign Pause Menu which lets you repeat the "Explanation"
[*]Updated Pause Menu text
[/list]

Look forward to another update within a week of the game's launch!
